messages:
sam_sales: Heads up — UK gov customer (IL3 datacenter) evaluating Redwood Private in a sealed/offline mode. Key asks: offline image delivery, patch cadence, license activation without internet, and KMS key handling. Anyone with quick constraints/risks?
ashley_se: @sam_sales we can support sealed installs. Main ops constraints: signed bundles, manifest checksums, and an offline license blob flow. Also need to confirm HSM/KMS exchange method.
devon_infra: For airgapped installs we produce an OCI tar + installer shim and a signed manifest.json with per-file sha256. Typical workflow: ship bundle -> customer loads to local registry/mirror.
devon_infra: Example verify command we ship:```
shipyardctl verify --bundle bundle.tar.gz --manifest manifest.json
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz
```
nisha_security: Note security constraints: customer allows only internal NTP and their PKI. No egress to external license endpoints. We must support license activation that is encrypted to their public key and validated purely offline. Legal will need to sign off on export controls for crypto.
ben_eng_infra: Upgrade cadence rec: quarterly for minor + monthly security-only hotfixes. For sealed sites we can offer delta patches to reduce transfer size. Rollback: keep previous bundle on local mirror and a `shipyardctl rollback` that re-applies prior manifest.
ashley_se: Commercial note — offline packaging is an SOW add-on: one-time packaging + per-release signing fee. I'll surface exact line items to procurement.
legal_qa: @sam_sales please share their security questionnaire. We'll need: signed NDA, IL3 attestation, and to confirm whether they permit HSM key escrow or only customer-managed keys. Also need to assess PIT for export / crypto paperwork.
sam_sales: Customer asked about emergency hotfixes: can we deliver a small signed hotfix (USB) that applies without reloading the full bundle?
devon_infra: Yes. We support hotfix tarballs: `shipyardctl apply --hotfix hotfix.tar.gz --verify`. Requires a pre-provisioned bootstrap token (stored in their vault) and the local operator to run the installer. Hotfixes are signed with our signing key; the verifier checks manifest + signature.
nisha_security: Also flag: all audit logs must stay on-prem. Our default for Private can write logs to a customer-supplied collector (syslog/ELK/OTel) and we will disable telemetry egress by default for sealed deals.
ashley_se: Next steps: I'll set up a 30m tech sync with their infra team. @legal_qa confirm export/crypto paperwork ETA. @devon_infra can you draft a 1-page blueprint for USB provisioning, delta patch flow, and rollback steps?
deploybot: deploybot: New doc created: /docs/offline/usb-provisioning.md — internal link: https://redwood.internal/docs/offline/usb-provisioning
sam_sales: Great — if we can get blueprint + pricing by EOW they are ready to commit to a short POC window. :thumbsup:
